- Automatic search for the running PC app on the connected network (firewall must allow port 3332 or 3333).
- Manual connection to IP and port.
- Demo mode available without connection, allowing you to showcase the app to your friends.

This app enables remote control of:
- Main buttons including freeze, blackout, favorite, and release all.
- Fog control with adjustable level.
- Master intensity control.
- Pan/tilt trackpad.
- Color picker for precise adjustments.
- Cue functionality with adjustable speed and selection via cuelist buttons.
- Fixture selection, either individual or grouped.
- Override buttons for additional control.
- Submasters control
- Locate fixture
